purpose: repo path -> whitelist path(s). devkit/payload_layout.py uses it (--repo) to place the git-resident files at the canonical payload paths that the devkit configuration expects. cpp_source whitelist paths are relative to root M2SRC, run_driver paths to root DEVKIT, all others are canonical payload paths (root PAYLOAD). Files with the same content under several whitelist paths are stored once.
